featured_reviews.name: Sanu kori
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely pathetic and unsafe service by Om Travels.
We booked a 12-seater mini bus from Mumbai (Malad) to Nashik, and what we got was a complete disaster. The bus was in terrible condition, couldn’t go beyond 70 km/h, and had no proper music system or basic comfort. It felt like a broken vehicle forced onto customers.
The worst part — on our return, after crossing Kasara Ghat, the bus broke down completely. Their response? “Wait 3 hours, mechanic is coming.” Totally unacceptable when you have 14 people stranded on the road at night.
No accountability, no backup, no concern for passenger safety. We had to rely on Umbarmali police for help, who finally got us to the station. Instead of reaching by 8 PM as planned, we reached at 1 AM by train.
This is not just bad service — it’s irresponsible and dangerous. I will NEVER recommend Om Travels to anyone. Avoid at all costs unless you want your trip ruined.

featured_reviews.name: sagar jadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
"Seeking a break from our daily grind, we decided on a trip to Mahabaleshwar for 3 days 2 nights partnering with Mahavir Travel to craft our ideal getaway. Ms. Maitri designed a thoughtful itinerary that exceeded our expectations.

Initially, we envisioned staying within Mahabaleshwar city, but Ms. Maitri's suggestion to stay at the Strawberry King Farm House, nestled away from the city which was proved to be an inspired choice. Our experience was nothing short of phenomenal:

- Hospitality: 10/10 (warm, welcoming, and attentive staff)
- Service: 10/10 (prompt, efficient, and personalized)
- Farm House: 10/10 (charming, cozy, and well-maintained)
- Food: 9/10 (delicious, fresh and farm fresh)

The farm house had breathtaking views during the sunset, which was truly unforgettable. It was the most peaceful stay and away from the chaos. We were also treated to the farm's own strawberry fields and farm-fresh, organic vegetables, adding a delightful touch to our stay.

Ms. Maitri's meticulous planning ensured a seamless sightseeing experience, covering all the must-visit attractions.

Our heartfelt thanks to Ms. Maitri from Mahavir Travels for an unforgettable trip! We eagerly anticipate our next adventure with them."
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Mr Sagar,

Thank you so much for sharing your wonderful experience with us. We’re truly delighted to know that your Mahabaleshwar trip turned out to be a memorable and refreshing escape.

It was a pleasure curating this getaway for you, and we look forward to assisting you with many more such travel experiences in the future.

-Team Mahavir Travel
